It becomes [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] and [[Ghost (Attribute)|Ghost]] and gets its speed halved, both of which last around 10 seconds, and spawns three [[Agent Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Agent Duckies]]. }} __TOC__ == Description == The '''Operator Ducky''' was an enemy that appeared exclusively in [[D00M's Revenge]] as part of the [[Duck Hunt Event]]. Currently, it can be spawned again in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. It had high health and an above average speed. When attacked in its non-[[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] state, it spawns three [[Agent Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Agent Duckies]] with its ''Secret Service'' ability, which could stun towers. It also briefly turns it into a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] and [[Ghost (Attribute)|Ghost]] enemy, limiting the amount of towers you could use against it, and also halves its speed. It lost its [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] and [[Ghost (Attribute)|Ghost]] attributes and the speed was reverted back to normal shortly after. Beyond wave 20, its health would increase over time. ==Appearance== The '''Operator Ducky''' is a black duck with black eyes, grey feet and an orange beak. It wears black translucent shades, cap and vest. When the ''Secret Service'' ability is activated, it briefly becomes entirely translucent and gains a red exclamation point above its head. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[D00M's Revenge]] is listed instead. *The '''Operator Ducky''' can spawn multiple [[Agent Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Agent Duckies]] if not dealt with quickly. **Towers like the [[Minigunner]] and [[Accelerator]] can be used to deal with '''Operator Ducky''' and the [[Agent Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Agent Duckies]] it spawns. ***The [[Ranger]] can also be used as the '''Operator Ducky''' does not immediately have the hidden and ghost immunities. At Level 3, it will be able to kill it in one shot before it can use its ''Secret Service'' ability. ***You can also use the [[Commander]] to decrease the firerate of these towers. *The [[Medic]] can be used to cleanse stuns from towers stunned by the [[Agent Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Agent Duckies]] that the '''Operator Ducky''' spawns. *A Level 5 [[Pursuit]] can be used to wipe out multiple '''Operator Duckies''' and [[Agent Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Agent Duckies]] easily, but do note that the [[Pursuit]] may lock onto a different enemy. **The [[Pursuit]]'s missiles can be quite useful as they can deal damage to both the '''Operator Ducky''' and [[Agent Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Agent Duckies]] at the same time. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseDROperatorDucky.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (16 April 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} DuckHuntEvent.png|'''Operator Ducky''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} Ducks3.png|'''Operator Ducky''' on a promotional image. DuckHuntPI.png|'''Operator Ducky''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator- Spring Trailer|'''Operator Ducky''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} LegacyOperatorDuckyIconIG.png|'''Operator Ducky''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The red exclamation point that appeared over the '''Operator Ducky''' during the ''Secret Service'' ability is a reference to the [[w:c:metalgear:Exclamation_point|exclamation point]] from the ''Metal Gear'' series. ==Update History== *'''17 April 2022''' - [[v1.2.0]] **'''Operator Ducky''' added. *'''28 May 2022''' - [[v1.2.4]] **'''Operator Ducky''' removed. *'''16 April 2025''' - [[v1.61.0]] ** '''Operator Ducky''' can now be summoned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, only when the player has the [[Operator Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Operator Ducky]]'s [[Logbooks|Logbook]] from the [[Ducky Revenge Event]]. **{{Bug}} No longer turns opaque 10 seconds after using its ''Secret Service'' ability. ==Notes== {{D00MRevenge|[[P3NGU (D00M's Revenge)|P3NGU]]|Wave 10|Operator Ducky|Wave 11|[[Explosive Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Explosive Ducky]]|Wave 13}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Operator Ducky}}
